scenes.anchor: here's what's inside
scenes.visual: Act card: locator lights '1 · what it checks'. A flat chalk side-section of a cylinder lock draws in, clean and big: shell (top block) and plug (round part).

scenes.anchor: the part you turn is called the plug
scenes.visual: The plug highlights (chalk fill brightens) and rotates a few degrees back and forth; label 'plug'. Then the shell highlights, label 'shell (fixed to the door)'. A small bolt at the end slides when the plug turns.
scenes.words: the part you turn is called the plug it sits inside a fixed shell and turning it is what moves the bolt

scenes.anchor: drilled down through both of them
scenes.visual: Five vertical holes drill down through shell and plug, one after another (left to right), as chalk outlines. Label '× 5 (usually)'.
changes: holes drill on 'row of small holes'
scenes.words: drilled down through both of them is a row of small holes usually five

scenes.anchor: in each hole sits a stack
scenes.visual: Close on one hole: a violet key pin drops in (pointed bottom), then a violet driver pin, then a muted spring compresses on top. Each labelled as it lands.
changes: key pin on 'key pin at the bottom'
scenes.words: in each hole sits a stack a key pin at the bottom a driver pin above it and a spring on top pushing them both down

scenes.anchor: the line where the plug meets the shell
scenes.visual: Pull back to all five stacks. The boundary between plug and shell draws as a bright violet line across all five holes: 'SHEAR LINE'.
scenes.words: the line where the plug meets the shell is called the shear line

scenes.anchor: with no key in the springs
scenes.visual: Springs push every driver pin down across the shear line; each crossing point gets a small muted 'bar'. The plug tries to turn and jolts to a stop: muted lock icon.
changes: drivers cross on 'push every driver pin'
scenes.words: with no key in the springs push every driver pin across that line into the plug the plug is pinned in place it can't turn

scenes.anchor: now slide the right key in
scenes.visual: HERO L1 hook again (3D, re-timed): the right key slides in, each stack rises to a different height, every split lands on the shear line, the line flashes violet, the plug turns. 2D overlay: five small height bars beside the stacks fill to different heights as the key passes; on 'all five gaps' a violet tick for each gap.
changes: gap ticks on 'exactly on the shear line'
scenes.words: now slide the right key in each cut lifts its stack to a different height and at the right height the gap between the two pins lands exactly on the shear line all five gaps on the line at once and the plug is free

scenes.anchor: that's the whole test
scenes.visual: The test as a card: five little vertical gauges, each with a violet target line; five dots slide up and land on the targets. Title 'THE WHOLE TEST'.
scenes.words: that's the whole test

changes: outline fades on 'outline of your key'
five points stay on 'at five points'
scenes.words: the pins never feel the outline of your key only how high it lifts them at five points

scenes.anchor: the shape of the slot does a rougher

changes: blanks try the slot on 'which blanks fit'
pins highlight on 'the pins do the real work'
scenes.words: the shape of the slot does a rougher check it decides which blanks fit in at all but the pins do the real work

scenes.visual: HERO L1 wrong (3D): a wrong key slides in; stack 1 sits too high and stacks 2 and 4 too low; those three glow violet as the culprits while the others dim; the plug tries to turn, stops, shakes. 2D overlay: small labels 'too high' over stack 1 and 'too low' over stacks 2 and 4 when they settle; 'locked' at the end. (Merged with the old S11 on 2026-11-25: the wrong-key shot needs more than 3 s.)
changes: 'too low' labels on 'stops short of the line'
scenes.words: cut one position wrong even slightly and a pin stops short of the line or pushes past it either way the plug stays locked
